messages:
kai_lim: Heads up — we're seeing a cluster of corrected + some uncorrectable ECCs and GPU driver errors on a subset of p4 hosts in us-east-2. Observed capacity loss ~11% as nodes are being drained automatically. infra-bot triggered at 1934567820. Anyone on this?

infra-bot: ALERT: nvml_error_rate > 5% in us-east-2-gpu-pool; auto-drain policy applied to 16 hosts. Links: https://alerts.redwood.io/incident/1934567820

marta_ops: Seeing repeated Xid entries in dmesg, example: ```kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, PID 2345, GPU 0 — followed by GPU reset request``` Also some `retired_pages` increments on affected devices.

sam_g: List from node exporter: host-ue2-08, host-ue2-09, host-ue2-12 are highest. I'm leaning toward replacement for host-ue2-08/09 if they keep flapping. For immediate mitigation we can route critical realtime traffic to dedicated-us-east-2-1 pool and enable model fallbacks.

lee_dev: Running quick NV query on host-ue2-12: ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,retired_pages --format=csv``` — temp 72C, util 48%, retired_pages=0 for that host right now. Attaching logs to the thread.

kai_lim: Please pause mass replacements until we confirm cause (thermal vs driver vs HW). Thermal sensors show a small spike but not catastrophic. We did roll driver bundle driver-535.86 last week — could be correlated. Any eu-west canaries to shift traffic to? Note inter-region spill will cost more and increase tail latency.

sam_g: Proposal: 1) enable smart-routing fallback to Dedicated for SLO-critical routes, 2) throttle batch size on non-critical heavy jobs to reduce pressure (~25% reduction), 3) run driver rollback on a canary host and observe for 10m before wider action.

marta_ops: Initiated rollback on host-ue2-12 -> driver-535.54. Telemetry verbosity raised for that host (`gpu.telemetry=debug`). Will watch Xid/ECC counters closely.

infra-bot: Deploy job deploy-2026-03-18-driver-rollback completed on host-ue2-12 at 1934567920.

lee_dev: host-ue2-12 stable for 7m post-rollback, no new Xid 31 events. host-ue2-08 still reports intermittent PCI errors, scheduling OOB GPU replacement if it doesn't settle in 30m.

oncall_rot: Notifying SRE oncall and customer ops. Rollout plan for next 4h: canary driver rollback -> if stable, staggered rollback on affected hosts; route critical traffic to dedicated pools; throttle batch-heavy routes; prepare hardware swaps for persistent flappers. ETA to improved capacity: 2-4 hrs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kai_lim: Quick cost callout — sustained cross-region routing to eu-west for >20% of traffic would add ~ $1.2k/hr in egress & instance delta. Finance/ops FYI so we can make tradeoffs if customer impact grows.

sam_g: Will keep watch and post updates. If other regions start reporting similar patterns, escalate to infra-ml for kernel/driver regression analysis. :thumbsup:
